description:
The Junior Data Analyst we are looking for works for an external market research client we are collaborating for more than a decade. Joining the team that works with top food manufacturers, drinks companies and leading retailers, you will have responsibilities in implementing operational tasks and enhancement of existing processes regarding data processing and delivery for international clients.

We are looking for…

... a team player, an open-minded and a professional, keen to work in a stable team with a bunch of like-minded colleagues!


As Junior Data Analyst you will have following key accountabilities:

  • Follow project timetables and ensure data deliveries from local offices in other countries within agreed deadlines & quality.
  • Monitors database, performs quality checks and plans DB transfers.
  • Assures support for reporting and operation teams.
  • Keep the management team/ key stakeholders updated on the project progress/ issues.
  • Develop solid working relationships with colleagues from different countries.
  • Sharing best practice amongst operation team.
  • Displays keen interest in new software developments, deploying these within deliverables as appropriate.
  • Building and maintenance of features for movement (e.g. EURO factor, promotions, planning, shop / category factors).
  • Quality checks and monitoring of data base for different teams (articles & movement).
  • Updating and running Item Quality Checks (manual & automated).
  • Ensure that all steps regarding articles references & movement are finished properly when coming to monthly database enclosures.
  • Support in the implementation of a request management system based on the ticket system JIRA.
  • Creation and maintenance of documentation on Confluence.

Now that we've introduced you to the position as Junior Data Analyst, what skills, qualifications and experience should you have?

  • University degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics.
  • 1 - 2 years’ experience in either Data Processing/Analysis (Project management experience would be a plus).
  • Competency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Teams etc.) and you are able to quickly pick up using bespoke software.
  • Have analytical mind, reporting skills and you are able to provide solutions to problems.
  • Able to effectively deliver tasks and projects against deadlines, working independently.
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Basic knowledge of programming and the use of simple programming languages (UNIX – it is a plus).

Our offer: 

  • 1y working contract.
  • A challenging job in a professional and multinational environment 
  • Opportunity to gain skills, knowledge, and experience.
